parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The names of the system plug-ins that you want to uninstall.

parameters.name: clientToken
parameters.description: A unique token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Specifies whether to forcefully uninstall the plug-in. You can cancel the installation of a plug-in that is being installed. This parameter is applicable only to instances of the new architecture. Default value: false.
